name: world.plan_compliance/downtown
about: QA casts rays over the whole of Downtown: along every lane and sidewalk, across every crosswalk, over every parcel, through every door and room, and down onto every point of interest. What they hit has the plan's heights and the surface tags of chapter 17.

expect.says: along every lane centre, sampled every 10 m, the road (tagged road) is at the lane's height within 0.10 m for at least 98% of the points
across every crosswalk band the surface is road surface at the road's height (within 0.10 m), tagged crosswalk
along every sidewalk ring, sampled every 10 m, the sidewalk (tagged sidewalk) is at its elevation within 0.05 m
every parcel zoned commercial, residential, civic or industrial has a building (tagged building) whose roof is at base_m + height_m within 0.5 m over at least 95% of its footprint
just outside each built parcel, on its sidewalk sides, the rays down meet no building surface
every plaza parcel is open ground at base_m within 0.05 m, tagged plaza
every park parcel is open ground at base_m within 0.05 m, tagged park
every parking parcel is open ground at base_m within 0.05 m, tagged parking
each door is an open doorway at least as wide and as high as the plan says
room p_00/main: from 0.10 m under its ceiling down, the first surface is its floor at floor_m within 0.10 m, tagged interior
room p_02/main: from 0.10 m under its ceiling down, the first surface is its floor at floor_m within 0.10 m, tagged interior
room p_04/main: from 0.10 m under its ceiling down, the first surface is its floor at floor_m within 0.10 m, tagged interior
room p_12/main: from 0.10 m under its ceiling down, the first surface is its floor at floor_m within 0.10 m, tagged interior
room p_17/main: from 0.10 m under its ceiling down, the first surface is its floor at floor_m within 0.10 m, tagged interior
room p_17/vault: from 0.10 m under its ceiling down, the first surface is its floor at floor_m within 0.10 m, tagged interior
every room is empty from its floor to 0.10 m under its ceiling
from just inside the door, nothing stands in the room it opens into
rooms listed together are joined by an opening at least 1.2 m wide (measured 1.0 m above the floor)
a ray down from 0.6 m above every point of interest hits a surface within 0.30 m of its height
every surface the rays hit is a world collider whose surface metadata is one of road, crosswalk, sidewalk, building, interior, plaza, park, parking, terrain, dock
